notes: Tabelle 4 is an enumeration table. Its caption fixes R4 = H, R5 = H, R6 = OH, L = CH2, Y = CH2, Z = CH2, v = 1, w = 0 and its 81 rows (Nr. 436-516) assign R1, R2 and R3. The only whole-molecule term the section itself names is the caption's pointer to the invention class, recorded here unresolved because formula (I) is defined elsewhere in the document. Five R1 cells (Nr. 472-475 and Nr. 476-480) carry drawn structures instead of text; the four IMAGE_EXTRACT spans on this page read as *OCC1CCCO1, an attachment-point substituent fragment ((oxolan-2-yl)methoxy), and the five spans for Nr. 476-480 read empty. All are R-group fragments, so none is emitted as a compound and none is added to aliases here.
